content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository pulp-platform_axi_pr224, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# Compilation error of axi_lite_mux_intf with XSim
I get errors when trying to simulate the axi_lite_mux_intf module with XSim, these are some of them:
ERROR: [VRFC 10-2991] 'aw' is not declared under prefix 'slv_reqs_i' [axi_lite_mux.sv:129]
ERROR: [VRFC 10-2991] 'aw_valid' is not declared under prefix 'slv_reqs_i' [axi_lite_mux.sv:130]
ERROR: [VRFC 10-2991] 'aw_ready' is not declared under prefix 'slv_resps_o' [axi_lite_mux.sv:131]
ERROR: [VRFC 10-2991] 'w' is not declared under prefix 'slv_reqs_i' [axi_lite_mux.sv:222]
ERROR: [VRFC 10-2991] 'w_valid' is not declared under prefix 'slv_reqs_i' [axi_lite_mux.sv:223]
I realized that the `axi_lite_mux` instantiation lacks the definition of the `axi_req_t` and `axi_resp_t` types, which are `logic` by default. I added these two lines and it works as expected:
```
axi_lite_mux #(
.aw_chan_t     ( aw_chan_t     ), // AW Channel Type
.w_chan_t      (  w_chan_t     ), //  W Channel Type
.b_chan_t      (  b_chan_t     ), //  B Channel Type
.ar_chan_t     ( ar_chan_t     ), // AR Channel Type
.r_chan_t      (  r_chan_t     ), //  R Channel Type
+   .axi_req_t     ( axi_req_t     ),
+   .axi_resp_t    ( axi_resp_t    ),
.NoSlvPorts    ( NoSlvPorts    ), // Number of slave ports
.MaxTrans      ( MaxTrans      ),
.FallThrough   ( FallThrough   ),
.SpillAw       ( SpillAw       ),
.SpillW        ( SpillW        ),
.SpillB        ( SpillB        ),
.SpillAr       ( SpillAr       ),
.SpillR        ( SpillR        )
)
```
So probably this is just it, or am I doing something wrong?
